versions.changelog:
- Major update: Added a comprehensive tutorial and user guide to SKILL.md, detailing installation, usage, human/AI collaboration, capabilities, and environment-specific reminders.
- Clear instructions for both Linux (cloud, NAS, local) and Windows environments, with step-by-step deployment and troubleshooting guidance.
- Emphasized security best practices: only expose noVNC (6080/tcp) and keep CDP debug port private.
- Defined progress feedback requirements and token usage estimates to manage user expectations.
- Updated description and metadata to highlight core strengths, including manual intervention during automations and strict CDP usage rules.
